cohort: Women with preterm singleton breech deliveries occurring after preterm labor or preterm premature rupture of membranes from 26(0/7) to 29(6/7) weeks of gestation.
finding: A policy of planned vaginal delivery for preterm breech singletons was not associated with increased risks of neonatal death or severe morbidity.
mod_finding: While three neonates (1.7%) died from head entrapment after vaginal delivery in the PVD group, the policy of PVD was not associated with increased risks of neonatal death or severe morbidity.
